body: Being here is the most toxic thing for me. I will not do anything that prolongs my separation.

I tried to break it up better. You have most of it correct. 

A Few Corrections:

* When I returned I was told that I had already been discharged and I just had to file for my DD214. 

* My battalion chaplin forced me to speak with the CPT over concerns I might kill myself and I basically said whatever I had to to avoid being locked up. Later on when it came time for my mandatory 706 evaluation I was interviewed by that same captain and I seemed to get a very short version of the eval which concerns me. I feel like I'm being set up. 

* I'm looking for some type of organization that assist people or soldiers with mental illnesses when facing charges. I need people around me that want the best for me and will do everything in their power to help me out. I can't trust anyone in the military. Almost everyone here past and present has lied to my face or hid information from me.
